about: The one answer key for how a till export is read, shared by the API and the web loader. The API owns every rule here (matching.normalize for names, takings.day_key for a day's identity, sales._signed_number for a number); the loader carries a copy so its preview is instant, and tests/test_till_keys.py and apps/web/src/lib/__tests__/tillKeys.test.ts both read this file, so a copy that drifts fails a test in both languages before it ships. Add a case here whenever a till prints something new.

days.why: a dish name printed with a dash one day and without it the next is the same day
trailing zeros and a leading zero are the same number
a whole quantity with and without its decimals
the same lines in another order
a code with spaces round it is the same code
a refund row makes a different day
a changed quantity makes a different day
no quantity is not a quantity of zero
